{{Flavor|The [[norn]] may have fled these lands, but their memories remain.}} | type = consumable | rarity = Exotic | bound = account | id = 93814 | requires = lws5 }} [[Memory of Otter]] is a [[consumable]] found in event chests in northern [[Drizzlewood Coast]] after unlocking the [[Significant Otter]] achievement. When consumed, it grants progress towards the achievement, providing extra rewards as well as the [[Ancient Norn Cape Pin|ascended amulet]] with the cosmetic [[Otter's Blessing Enrichment]] upon completion. == Mechanics == Memories of Otter start dropping from [[Tribune's Chest]]s and the [[Magnificent Chest (Claw of Jormag)|Magnificent Chest]] in the northern [[Drizzlewood Coast]] meta event after the Significant Otter achievement is unlocked. They will continue dropping after the achievement has been completed — additional copies can be used to purchase extra [[Otter's Blessing Enrichment]]s from [[Laurel Merchant]]s. Memories can only be used after unlocking the [[Significant Otter]] achievement, even though its possible to obtain them by salvaging [[Charged Stormcaller weapons|Charged]] and [[Volcanic Stormcaller weapons]] before that. Consuming a Memory after completing the achievement will trigger a random animation even if a character doesn't have the enrichment equipped. Only unconsumed Memories can be used to purchase additional copies of [[Otter's Blessing Enrichment]]. Consuming Memories after the [[Significant Otter]] achievement is complete will not count towards the progress of additional copies. As of the current research a Tribune's Chest yields 1.2 Memories on average and the Magnificent Chest yields 6 Memories on average. This adds up to 12 Memories per full [[Drizzlewood Coast#North|northern meta event]], requiring ~27 meta runs to complete the Significant Otter achievement (320 Memories). Drop research from Tribune's Chest and Magnificent Chest can be found [[Memory of Otter/Drop Rate|here]]. == Acquisition == === Gathered from === * 1-3 drop from the [[Tribune's Chest]]s after defeating each Dominion Tribune in the Northern [[Drizzlewood Coast]] meta * 4-9 drop from the [[Magnificent Chest (Claw of Jormag)|Magnificent Chest]] after defeating the [[Claw of Jormag]] in [[Claw's Roost]] === Sold by === {{Sold by}} === Salvaged from === * [[Charged Stormcaller weapons]] (10 per weapon) * [[Volcanic Stormcaller weapons]] (10 per weapon) == Currency for == {{vendor query table|currency=Memory of Otter}} == Related achievements == * {{achievement|Significant Otter}} == Notes == {{anomaly|Salvaging a Stormcaller weapon will yield memories of otter, even if the [[Jormag Rising (achievements)#achievement5350|Significant Otter]] achievement is not unlocked.}} [[de:Erinnerung des Otters]] [[es:Recuerdo de la Nutria]] [[fr:Souvenir de la Loutre]]
